limitations: The FIFO read, register getters, packet allocation/release, decoder, orientation remap and SPI callbacks execute in the sensor-hub emulator; transfer, heap, memset/memcpy, timestamp, packet queue, algorithm hook, events, restore, dump comparator, delay and logger are supplied.
This caller builds an accelerometer-only packet: gyroscope-tagged words are skipped by the decoder (no gyroscope header is passed); the gyroscope delivery path is elsewhere.
Orientation index, wrist flag and calibration offsets are .bss values set at runtime by other code; the cases author them. The transmitted bulk-read bytes are recorded up to 16 bytes.
FIFO contents are synthetic tagged words; no real LSM6DSO FIFO, timing or interrupt delivery is observed.

header.+0x16: u16 rate rounded down to a multiple of 25

packet.timestamp: source timestamp - (1000 / rate) * words left in the FIFO
